How it started

A common friend of ours was on a video call with me while I was travelling, and turned the camera to show me you. That's it — that's the whole beginning. No grand plan, just a friend who unknowingly introduced me to the person I'd fall for. Some love stories start with fireworks; ours started with a shaky video call and a screen too small for how big this would become.
